create_language_filter: create a LanguageFilter instance to filter documents by language using fasttext backend
filter_documents_by_language: filter a document stream to keep only documents matching specified languages and score threshold
configure_glotlid_backend: configure LanguageFilter with glotlid backend for language and script detection
add_language_labels_only: add language labels to document metadata without removing any documents using label_only mode
keep_top_language_pairs: keep top language prediction pairs above a threshold in document metadata
